clips.title: The story
paras: Among the ruins of Bathran's Haunt in northwestern Ashenvale, Bathran's Hair remains a rare herb. Night elf healers value its power against afflictions of the flesh and spirit.

Bathran's Hair grows among the ancient ruins north of Maestra's Post, where night elf healers have long valued it. Common herbs soothe wounds of the body, but Bathran's Hair is said to restore the spirit as well. When a young night elf in Astranaar falls gravely ill, herbalist Orendil Broadleaf seeks the rare plant to prepare a remedy.
